arguments.hindsight: I needed a deeper initial band grasp, a verified cradle alignment from a second view, and a more efficient transfer. Repeated slips and wrist corrections exhausted the motion budget before laptop storage.
arguments.reason: The headphones fell off the cradle after release, and only 29 environment steps remain—insufficient to recover and store both objects.
